suites.title: Eve Vakh - Login Page Functional & Button Test Suite

specs.title: TC-01: should display all initial login page elements and auxiliary controls
TC-02: should switch between OTP mode and Password mode seamlessly
TC-03: should verify password masking, show-password toggle and legal links
TC-04: should complete login with password and navigate through Chat, Activity, and Explore
TC-05: submitting password exceeding 128 characters is handled cleanly without server timeout or 500 error
TC_AUTH_012: submitting a password with only whitespace characters or an empty string shows a mandatory validation error
TC_AUTH_013: entering alphanumeric or special characters into the OTP verification input is blocked and only numeric digits are accepted
TC_AUTH_014: boundary lengths for phone numbers: entering fewer than 7 digits or more than 15 digits displays invalid phone length error
TC_AUTH_015: entering Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) script tags in email/username/password inputs does not execute scripts and is safely escaped/rejected
TC_AUTH_016: email addresses with leading or trailing whitespaces are automatically trimmed upon submission and authenticated successfully
TC_AUTH_017: entering malformed email addresses displays an immediate inline validation error preventing form submission
TC_AUTH_018: logging in when user account is in 7-day scheduled deletion window presents confirmation modal allowing cancellation or proceeding
TC_AUTH_019: attempting to log in on Day 8 for a deleted account fails with Account does not exist and does not allow restoration
